text:
Priya Rao: FYI marketplace security sent a checklist for the SI listing. They want SOC2 summary, a redacted pen-test report, and an artifact upload window (presigned S3). Can we align on what we can hand over and who owns the upload + retention? Deadline EOD Wed for the marketplace intake.
Sam Patel: We can produce a SOC2 summary (redacted) + pen-test executive summary. Full raw reports need legal ok. For presigned URLs, recommend 7 days expiry and access logs enabled. :thinking_face:
Luis Gomez: Eng can spin presigned URLs and a dedicated bucket path. We'll enforce SSE-KMS and restrict by principal. Example command we can hand to partners:
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace/partner-evidence/si-123/report.pdf --expires-in 604800
```
Also we'll create an upload folder: s3://redwood-marketplace/partner-evidence/si-123/
Jordan Lee: From the SI side, we'll have: scan_output.csv, infra_diagram.pdf, config_snippets.tar.gz. Some items may contain internal IPs — our team can scrub, but would prefer a defined redaction checklist.
Alex Morgan: Legal note: marketplace requires an attestation and proof of consent for redaction. We should add a short attestation template and confirm whether an NDA is required for artifact access. I can draft language today.
Sam Patel: Redaction checklist (draft): remove PII, remove full hostnames if not needed, mask internal IPs, strip SSH keys, and remove raw application logs. I'll put this in a quick doc and share.
Priya Rao: Great. Action owners: Sam = redaction checklist + attach SOC2 summary; Luis = create bucket + presign workflow + perms; Jordan = gather artifacts and pre-scrub where possible; Alex = attestation template + NDA recommendation. I'll follow up with marketplace PM once we have the artifact path and timeline. @IntegrationBot please open a tracking ticket.
IntegrationBot: Created ticket INF-4321: "marketplace - SI artifact handoff (si-123)" and assigned to Priya, Sam, Luis, Jordan, Alex. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-4321 :robot_face:
Luis Gomez: Quick note on retention: will set lifecycle to auto-delete after 30 days unless compliance requests extension. We can increase logging retention for the bucket for 90 days.
Jordan Lee: 30 days OK for initial upload. If reviewer needs more time we'll request extension via the ticket. Also can you add a checksum file requirement (sha256) so we can validate uploads?
Luis Gomez: Yep — require <filename>.sha256 alongside each artifact. We'll add a small upload script snippet for partners.
Priya Rao: Perfect. I'll update marketplace PM: expect SOC2 summary + redaction checklist by EOD Tue, presigned upload path by morning Wed, artifacts uploaded by EOD Wed. Everyone please update INF-4321 with any blockers. :thumbsup:
Sam Patel: I'll ping security reviewer to prioritize redaction review. :eyes:
Alex Morgan: Drafting attestation now, will drop in ticket and ping legal reviewer. Should we require a signed attestation PDF or is a simple text form OK for marketplace?
Priya Rao: Marketplace prefers signed attestation PDF when available. If partner can't sign, we'll accept an emailed attest from a named exec + integration slack confirmation. We'll note that in the ticket.
Jordan Lee: On it — prepping artifacts and checksum, will coordinate upload times to avoid collisions. Thanks all.
Priya Rao: Thanks team. Small follow-up: Luis - can you also add a short TTL for the presigned links in the upload email? Partner will need clear instructions.
Luis Gomez: Will do. Suggested text:
"Upload to: s3://redwood-marketplace/partner-evidence/si-123/ — each file must have a corresponding .sha256. Links expire in 7 days. Use server-side encryption (SSE-KMS). Contact infra@redwood.com for issues."
Priya Rao: Excellent. Closing loop — I'll post final message to marketplace PM after INF-4321 has the checklist and bucket path. :white_check_mark:
